slides.title: What residents told Addis Standard
slides.body: Young people who buried the dead or helped the wounded were reportedly held. One resident was released after 24 hours. Grounds for the arrests are unclear.

slides.title: Why people were gathering
slides.body: The Holy Synod of the Orthodox Church reported lives lost in attacks on Oct 20 and 24. Residents say mourners, including women, were also detained.

slides.title: What the authorities say
slides.body: A regional official blamed an armed group for the violence but gave no account of the detentions. Addis Standard could not reach the bureau. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate independently. Respect due process.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
